Neither structured-product status nor section 103 authorisation should become a prerequisite or exception to the gift control.

Scope placement changes executable answers. node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e returns OUT_OF_SCOPE when the component is not offered; node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f does so when the linked offer condition is false. The component question instead defines FALSE as not caught. Retain the alternative interpretation that these are deliberate applicability boundaries, but resolve it explicitly before treating these candidates as equivalent to node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 or node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b.

Similarly, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 place promotion conditions in Scope, returning OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than FALSE when those conditions fail. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 also limits its compliance answer to linked promotions. These boundaries need reconciliation with the typed questions; they do not establish general permission.

The offer-level candidates combine an offer-level promotional link with an existential non-discount gift component. For mixed offers, establish that the gift component itself bears the required promotional connection; otherwise the formula may combine facts about different components and overstate the restriction.

The circular supports the distributor definition through db43e253bea18.u0.2, but node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f additionally limits the promoted specific product to an SFC-authorised fund. Paragraph 10 describes a "specific investment product". Whether the narrower wording merely reflects this circular's application or excludes covered cases remains unresolved.

The complete paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC Code of Conduct FAQs issued on 30 September 2010, identified by footnote 3, are absent. Their absence does not negate the circular's express gift rule, but prevents checking additional qualifications or definitive gift classifications against those authorities.

No supplied operative date interval substantiates the candidates' stated temporal basis. The runtime treatment of unavailable facts preserves uncertainty but does not establish which legal version applies.

The funding and fulfilment independence stated by node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b is not expressly resolved by the circular. Its actor-specific offer attribution is useful, but third-party arrangements require assessment rather than an unsupported categorical attribution rule.
